data.gender_notes: Qaisarah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Qaisarah is derived from the Arabic word 'Qaysar', meaning 'Caesar' or 'Emperor', signifying power and royalty. In Islamic context, it is associated with feminine virtues. The name Qaisarah carries the meaning “Empress or Queen” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Qaisarah usually hope their child will grow to embody empress or queen and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes strength and leadership, reflecting the qualities of a just and compassionate ruler as guided by Islamic principles.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qaisarah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
